messages:
Ibrahim: Heads-up 6 the partner SDK auth header is being renamed from `X-RW-Auth` -> `RW-Auth`. This is low-risk for web SDKs but a bunch of legacy SI integrations and marketplace connectors pin on exact header name. Need compatibility path and comms. @Leah @Omar

Leah: Can we accept both headers for 90 days? Add server-side header aliasing immediately and ship SDK update that normalizes to `RW-Auth` by default.

Omar: Alias is fine. For hardware partners, some firmware only accepts single-word headers (no dash). Uh. They might rely on `X-RW-Auth`. We need to enumerates partners with firmware constraints.

Docs-Bot: Found 8 marketplace connectors referencing `X-RW-Auth` in the marketplace manifest. Suggested PR to marketplace manifests to add `compat_headers: ["X-RW-Auth"]` field.

Partner-Eng-1: Confirmed one SI partner uses a tiny reverse-proxy that strips unknown headers; they will break if we remove `X-RW-Auth` without alias.

Ibrahim: Timeline proposal: immediate server aliasing + telemetry; docs update by EOD; SDK release in 2 weeks; deprecated header removed after 90 days. I'll prep partner email template.

Leah: Also track requests by partner id that include `X-RW-Auth` so we can follow up with high-usage partners. I'll add a metric to partners.telemetry.header_usage.

Omar: For the firmware oddity, suggest we publish an escape hatch: response header `X-RW-Compat: auth-header` set for those partners. Their proxies/firmware can detect that and continue to work. We'll also add a marketplace flag to opt-in to alias behavior.

Partner-Eng-1: Will reach out to SI partner and offer a small shim container they can run for 60 days.

Ibrahim: Great. I'll drop the partner outreach list here tomorrow and schedule a partner-facing note on the community board. Keep updates in this thread.
